detail: Full summary: Method note: mutation testing alone was insufficient here and would have produced false confidence. A scorer can catch 24 of 28 mutants and still be a constant on real data — which is exactly what happened, 96.1% of 1075 real stores scoring exactly 100. Any new scoring instrument needs a discrimination check against real recorded data, not just a passing test suite.
